name: services/housing/dormrooms
description: Get information on multiple dormitory rooms.
brief_description: Get information on multiple dormitory rooms.

arguments.name: dormroom_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of dormitory room IDs.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of dormroom method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary. Your dormroom_ids will be its keys. Values will be dormroom objects, or nulls, if no dormroom by such ID was found OR your user doesn't have proper permissions to see it.
